title: The Baby Who Jumped for Joy
book: The New Testament, January 2027 (Come and See!)
p1: After the angel left, Mary hurried into the hills to see her cousin Elisabeth. Elisabeth was going to have a baby too, baby John.
Mary came in and called hello. The moment Elisabeth heard Mary’s voice, her baby jumped for joy!
The Holy Ghost filled Elisabeth. She knew Mary’s baby would be the Lord.
p2: Elisabeth’s voice was loud and happy. “You are blessed, Mary, and so is your baby! You believed Heavenly Father’s words, and they will come true.”
Even a tiny baby can feel joy when Jesus is near. Tonight, think of someone who makes you want to jump for joy. Thank Heavenly Father for them.
note: Rewritten the picture-book way and rated 9-10 by a reviewer that did not write it (29 Oct 2026).
